content.summary: Shares of solar power systems company SolarEdge (NASDAQ:SEDG) jumped 2.4% in the afternoon session after an analyst at UBS raised the firm's price target on the stock to $40 from $30. This suggested that while the firm saw more potential value in the stock, it was not signaling a strong recommendation to buy.
